meta.name: image-video-generation
meta.description: Unified cookbook for TeamDay's AI image + video production stack. Models (Seedream 5, Seedream 4, Flux 2, Kling, Wan, Seedance 2.0), endpoints (ByteDance ModelArk direct, FAL AI, Gemini, OpenAI, Grok), scripts, proven settings, pitfalls. Use this skill when orchestrating any multi-step image+video generation pipeline, when deciding which model to use, or when reverse-engineering a reference video's style.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 照着统一配方生成图片和视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常在AI生图选模型和调参数上花太多时间。
copy.tagline_en: Follow a unified recipe to produce images and videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle choosing AI models and tuning settings for image generation.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在处理图像与视频生成任务时,会按本技能流程走:先选模型(如 Seedream、Kling、Wan),再调用对应脚本生成关键帧与视频,并做后期(调色、配乐、片尾等);同时会记录每次调用费用,并在会话结束时报累计花费。
howto.when: 当用户要求做多步骤图像+视频生成、需要挑选合适的生成模型,或想分析参考视频的风格时,Claude 会读取并使用本技能。

say.text: 帮我用 Seedream 5 生成一张 16:9 的曼哈顿夜景关键帧图片。
say.note: 会调用对应脚本生成 2K 图片并返回链接。

say.text: 把这张关键帧转成一段电影感视频,用 Seedance 2.0 Fast。
给这段视频加上 TeamDay 片尾和背景音乐。
say.note: 会添加官方片尾并对音频做淡入淡出。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude uses this skill for image+video tasks: picks a model (Seedream, Kling, Wan…), runs corresponding scripts to make keyframes/videos, then post-processes (grading, music, endcard). It also logs every call cost and reports total spend.
howto.when_en: When the user asks for a multi-step image+video generation pipeline, needs a model choice, or wants to reverse-engineer a reference video's style, Claude reads and uses this skill.

say_en.text: Generate a 16:9 cinematic night shot of Manhattan with Seedream 5.
say_en.note: Calls the Seedream script and returns a 2K image link.

say_en.text: Turn this keyframe into a cinematic video with Seedance 2.0 Fast.
Add the TeamDay endcard and background music to this video.
say_en.note: Runs video-editor scripts to append endcard and mix audio.
